item.title: Audio Rendition
item.content:encoded:
Six years ago, almost to the day, TheVolgun made this wonderful audio rendition of my tale, and I would just like to commemorate it here.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3KmxwZ2B9VM

On a related note, there seems to have been some debate about the YouTube user "Connor Anborough" (which until recently had a different name) that commented on the video, claiming to be the original author. I would just like to confirm that that YouTube user is indeed me.

item.title: I liked it!
item.content:encoded:
I liked this way more than I expected to. It very much felt like an in-universe source giving someone that old shrug from the comic books.

"You don't like it? Then it's not canon." and the idea that even within the Universe, the people within basically have to decide what their particular reality is, is both very frightening (from the in-universe perspective) and very amusing (from the meta perspective).

Take my upvote.

item.content:encoded: Things don't make sense, stop looking for them to make sense. All patterns are chance. The world has ended more times than we can ever tell. item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Although I subscribe to the notion that the Foundation does have a 001 on file, albeit more like Gears' 'gribbly monster that happened to be first' than Clef's Blues Brothers 'mission from god' origin, I do like this a lot. It syncs quite well with my notion that the distinction between 'anomalous' and 'non-anomalous' isn't a natural one but rather man-made by the Foundation, and that the laws of physics only appear to be universal because the Foundation is so good at keeping the exceptions to the rules under wraps. Also a nice nod to headcanon at the end there. +1
